review: Six full files reviewed: workstation presence, voice bridge and hook, synthetic presence/media tests. No media recordings, credentials or live account values included.
Presence requires the current profile and Friends policy and discards stale profile results. It runs at workstation scope; its shell importer is located but remains a separate source-review input.
Voice startup is single-flight and rechecks closure after reporting connection, ICE admission and microphone acquisition. Tracks obtained after close are stopped without creating WebRTC or signaling.

The hook invalidates pending restart attempts on Stop, unmount or exact party/member identity change. Late projection callbacks cannot update the successor selection. Late transport statistics cannot report a closed connection as current.
Regression fixtures use fake tracks, mocked WebRTC/ICE/signaling and reserved example domains. Consent, actual microphone acquisition, audio, hosted room and paid model operations were not performed.
limits: Private source proposal only; no commit, push, package, deployment or new authority.
Two production voice files changed after R378; this fix is not in any qualified installed package.
Shared contracts, party API, signaling/playback/recovery and workstation shell are separate dependencies.
Component tests do not qualify real audio, two-player Discord/GPT Live, signed ordinary-account operation or the complete release.
